H342.scope: Separate data-derived Hessian floor; no H343 source or decision changes
H342.interpretation: Published PREREG explicitly derives 9.87 globally from972archived TRAIN rankers, not inside eachouterfold. LambdaRank leaf Hessians depend on fitted margins/labels, so the fixed scalar carries historical TRAIN information across folds. No outcome-based hyperparameter selection was performed, but this is not an independently learned outer-fold-local scalar. This conditional-protocol caveat does not establish benefit/harm or invalidate own worker physical-read checks.

H338.interpretation: Ranker feature_fraction_bynode=.8 plus an explicit feature_fraction_seed changes node sampling and the seed used by existing tree-level sampling. This two-keyword intervention does not isolate only node-level sampling and cannot substitute for the H343 max_bin test. Its non-advancement is conditional on reused TRAIN and the preregistered protocol.
